nodes.natural_language: Let $f(n)$ be a function $f: \mathbb{N}^{+}\to\mathbb{N}^{+}$. Prove that if $ f(n+1) > f(f(n)) $ for each positive integer $n$, then $f(n)=n$.
nodes.statement: Let $f(n)$ be a function $f: \mathbb{N}^{+}\to\mathbb{N}^{+}$. Prove that if $ f(n+1) > f(f(n)) $ for each positive integer $n$, then $f(n)=n$.
